simple.meaning: תְּמוּנָה (tᵉmûwnâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something portioned (i.e. fashioned ) out, as a shape , i.e. (indefinitely) phantom , or (specifically) embodiment , or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תְּמוּנָה (H8544) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 20:4, with occurrences in Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּמוּנָה (H8544) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תְּמוּנָה (H8544) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תְּמוּנָה (tᵉmûwnâh) / H8544 is traced through Exodus 20:4, Numbers 12:8, Deuteronomy 4:12, Deuteronomy 4:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.

When you shall father children and children’s children, and you shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,
“You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance.
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness.
